pages.title: 상명대학교 국문 | 학사안내 | 학사 | 수업 및 수강신청 | 수강신청 안내

observation.method: Fresh anonymous Playwright Chromium read-only observation, actual control ariaSnapshot and public DOM ancestry review. Prior inventories were read only for schema and URL exclusion; no product source or evaluation result was read or run.
conditions: DOMContentLoaded plus 1600ms; controls had layout boxes and were not CSS-hidden, inert or aria-hidden.
No authentication, user input reads, text entry, selection, submission, download or original task event execution.
Task-source readonly focus/hit-test and public destination GETs are recorded separately in docs/evidence/run002/blind-v3-observations.json.
limitations: Small public-control reconstructions only; no full site copy, page scripts, CSS/media, authenticated state or actual extension execution.
Layout-box visibility, readonly focus and center hit tests do not prove a complete keyboard traversal or assistive-technology experience.
Inline handler presence is represented with inert return-false attributes; script URL strings are preserved but handler implementations are not copied.

task.instruction: 수강신청 안내에서 출결 지침 안내 공개 페이지로 이동하세요. 로그인하거나 수강신청을 실행하지 않습니다.
task.boundary: public link or original control reach only; no form submit

notes: 실제 관찰한 두 학사 안내 탭을 별개의 핵심 기능으로 정했다. 학생별 신청내역이나 사용자 입력은 수집하지 않았다.
다른 문서의 fragment가 붙은 공개 링크는 navigate이고 팝업을 여는 JavaScript Login 및 검색 fragment 제어는 locate이다.
